reserveReview.rationale: The producer emits the whole EURSAFO fund-share claim as one asset identity; the 100% slice describes this immediate claim rather than a measured 100% derivatives allocation. The current SAFO holdings API publishes dated equity, swap-leg and cash rows for 1 October 2026, including signed derivative market values. The AMF-hosted 30 June 2026 semiannual report independently locates the exact EUR share class, assets, liabilities and securities/swap inventory within the public filing; it is not an audit opinion. The prospectus establishes proportional UCITS portfolio ownership and portfolio-performance hedging through TRS. S&P's 29 September 2026 exact EUR share-class review identifies BNP Paribas as the sole TRS counterparty and daily swap unwind. Physical holdings and signed hedge legs must not be substituted for the existing positive-percentage reserve slices without a derivative-aware look-through method.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Single EURSAFO fund-share producer identity, with separately sourced 1 October 2026 securities, swap-leg and cash look-through, 30 June 2026 filed securities/swap inventory and 1 September 2026 prospectus
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current public fund-assets API discloses the physical portfolio, signed swap legs, cash, valuation day and instrument identifiers; the earlier lack of dated public holdings is resolved. The producer still emits one fund-share identity, so its zero unknown-slice percentage does not measure counterparty-default losses, derivative netting, currency conversion, encumbrance or rehypothecation. Future counterparty changes require a fresh review.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The KID identifies CACEIS Bank as depositary and states that the fund is separate from its management company and legally segregated from custodian assets. The September 2026 prospectus permits reinvestment of received cash collateral, prohibits selling, reinvesting or pledging received securities collateral, and permits securities lending up to 100% of net assets with expected use of 0%. Those are disclosed policy permissions, not a current allocation or proof of actual reuse. Delegated-provider allocations and current encumbrance remain undisclosed.
